title: Protesters against the white train and the Nevada test site

tellings.quote: most of my time is fought against protesters trying to wipe out the white train or go to the nuclear site in in Nevada.

plain: During the 1980s, much of the job of a senior official named John S. Herrington was taken up with protesters, he says. He served as US Secretary of Energy, and he describes them as people trying to stop a train he calls the white train or trying to get onto the nuclear test site in Nevada. He tells this from his own time in office, and it gives a picture of the pressures on the man in charge of that nuclear work.
